title: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Hathaway Chairman
summary: “Father Time always wins,” the 96-year-old, who turned Berkshire Hathaway into an investing powerhouse, said in a letter to shareholders. He will remain on the board as chairman emeritus.
